reasons.persona_fit: Directly addresses small business owner-operators in a calm, practical tone without hype, respects Bareni boundaries, and includes no CTA as specified.
reasons.clarity: Logical flow from diagnostic mapping to pilot scoping, using plain explanations of how data handoffs and subprocessors constrain architecture.
reasons.actionability: Provides a clear, practical method to map data handoffs for one workflow and make the subprocessor list an explicit constraint before building.
reasons.factual_grounding: Accurately reflects Bareni operating boundaries, including mandatory human approval for money movement, without claiming invented customers or capabilities.
